subject: mercator projection of world map with coord_map()

messages.author: 6a3b777d6a18967b
messages.subject: mercator projection of world map with coord_map()
parts:
I am attempting to add a mercator projection to a map of the world and am getting output that looks wrong. 

Here is my source code and resulting images:

library(ggplot2)
library(choroplethrMaps) # v1.0
data(country.map)

# cartesian projections looks fine
ggplot(country.map, aes(long, lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon() 

# mercator projection looks wrong
ggplot(country.map, aes(long, lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon() + 
  coord_map()

It is only country.map that has this problem for me. state.map and county.map work fine.

I am running R 3.2.0 under Mac OS 10.10.3. I am running ggplot2 1.0.1.

Any help would be appreciated. Thanks.

Ari
